activity_summary: Alse banked the one hall fire and would not lay a plate for you. You told her not to. Mistress Ansell had the spoons in her hands and would not discuss Blackfriars. Alse did not ask about the ass again. You said you would be late, and that no one was to sit up.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a plate and refused a vigil.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Banked the fire, laid no plate, and did not ask a second question.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the spoons in her hands and would not reopen six.

facets.activity: Spoke at the hall door before supper

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: One fire. It is for the people who are eating.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I have the spoons in my hand and I am not putting them down to discuss Blackfriars.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: I am not asking about the ass.
